events.verdict: Hart (NYK) is moving alongside Mitchell's (TOR) path with a rested forearm on Mitchell's side and marginal contact occurs as Hart defends the driving shot attempt.
Brunson (NYK) is bracing for the impending contact with Barrett (TOR) following the defensive switch and absorbs it as it occurs in the post.
Brunson (NYK) moves forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with Barrett (TOR) as Barrett receives the pass.

Brunson (NYK) initiates illegal contact across Barrett's (TOR) left arm. The initial contact occurs prior to the start of Barrett's upward shooting motion and the play was correctly deemed to be a non-shooting foul.
Dick (TOR) is turning away from Towns (NYK) as he braces for the impending contact during the pick, which he does not deliver illegally.

Barrett (TOR) goes to, not through, Bridges' (NYK) space and marginal contact is made as the two come together at the end of Barrett's drive. Simultaneously, Dick (TOR) is absorbing the contact that occurs during the aforementioned pick and further incidental contact occurs as his momentum carries him toward Bridges.
Poeltl (TOR) makes incidental arm contact with Towns (NYK) after making initial contact with the ball during the rebound.
Dick (TOR) moves toward Brunson (NYK) with his right arm brought forward and marginal contact occurs with Brunson's upper body as he dribbles over the pick.
Poeltl (TOR) and Towns (NYK) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound. While the ball is still loose, Poeltl lowers his arm and the arm contact with Towns is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) turns slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with Barrett (TOR) after Barrett's gather.
Dick (TOR) and Barrett (TOR) each legally contest Towns' (NYK) layup attempt.
Poeltl (TOR) establishes a screening position in Anunoby's (NYK) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Towns (NYK) is moving alongside Barrett's (TOR) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs at the end of the drive to his chest.
Towns (NYK) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Barrett (TOR). Anunoby (TOR) then cleanly blocks Barrett's (TOR) shot attempt and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Agbaji (TOR) and Bridges (NYK) are moving toward one another as they each pursue the rebound and incidental body contact occurs when they come together.
Barrett (TOR) legally contests Towns' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Agbaji (TOR) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Walter's (TOR) right foot steps out of bounds after he receives the inbound pass. Possession is correctly awarded to New York.
Agbaji (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Hart (NYK) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
